annotations.title: Delete a piece of your own

description: Take one of the user's own pieces away (see search_library { mine: true }). It needs confirm: true, and the user's word first. On their machine the file is moved to .trash/; on their account (« Mes pièces ») it is erased. Films that already use the piece keep it and keep working: they carry it.

confirm.description: Must be true: say so only once the user agreed

id.description: The id of one of the user's pieces
